title: On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2610.00382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method

translated_title: 关于模型量化与模型反转攻击之间关系的研究
translated_abstract: 模型量化通过降低神经网络权重和激活值的数值精度来减少存储和计算成本。模型反转攻击则从模型输出或中间特征中恢复或重构敏感的训练数据或推理输入，因此量化也可能改变这类攻击的有效性。然而，目前仍有两个问题悬而未决：模型量化如何影响模型反转？数据特性如何影响这种关系？针对第一个问题，我们对量化引起的输入与由预测概率定义的分类变量之间互信息的变化进行了界定，从而将信息层面的效应与攻击优化的障碍区分开来。针对第二个问题，我们识别出特征分布和反转结果中依赖于数据的差异，在4比特量化下敏感性差异尤为显著。这些见解进而指导了一种隐私感知的训练后量化方法的设计。
tldr: 本文首次系统量化分析了模型量化对模型反转攻击的影响——通过界定互信息变化区分信息效应与优化障碍，揭示了数据特性（尤其在4比特下）导致的量化敏感性差异，并据此提出了一种隐私感知的训练后量化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically quantifies how model quantization affects model inversion attacks by bounding mutual information changes to distinguish informational effects from optimization obstacles, reveals data-dependent quantization sensitivity differences (notably at 4 bits), and uses these insights to propose a privacy-aware post-training quantization method.
